title: Permit Document Archive Backlog
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:permit trade=* archive_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(archive_state!="archived",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by trade
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending permit files backlog by trade for permit record-keeping.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside permit record-keeping.
implementation: Mark each `reno:permit` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `trade`.
visualization: Table of trade with pending permit files counts.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers where unfinished permit files are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in permit record-keeping.
